- 2021/12 - 2023/12: video transcoding accelerator

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Led NVMe firmware development team of 20 people to successfully deliver consumer/enterprise SSD.
* Contributed to architect/design in-house enterprise SSD controller
* Design and architect consumer/enterprise SSD from scratch for new platform, and is using for all of NVMe/SATA SSD production.
* Improved the firmware development process to improve the productivity of the team and quality of the firmware.
* Successfully delivered firmware on multiple NVMe SSDs (PE4110, PC400, PC401 and PE3110) Production.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer (2011.03 - 2015-07)
* Led NVMe firmware development tream of 11 people to successfully deliver enterprise SSD firmware.
* Architect enterprise SSD firmware by collaborating with Samsung San Jose team.
* A lot of performance/QoS optimization by re-architecturing existing firmware.
* Successfully delivered firmware on multiple SSDs (PM1725, PM1633a, XS1715/SM1715/SM1715a)
* Contributed to design PM1633a controller to make very large capacity SSD controller.
* Worked closely with Program Manager, Planning team and customers in building the product on time

Senior Software Engineer(2008.03 - 2011.02)
* Design and implement Flash management firmware including mapping, garbage collection, and error recovery for various SSDs.
* Participated in high performance SSD firmware development project. Defined firmware architecture by leveraging many-core SSD controller

Software Engineer(2005.01 - 2008.02)
* Implemented key flash management firmware features such as wear-leveling and error recovery to support MLC media.
* FTL simulator and test software development for storage validation.
* Successfully delivered flash management software for MP3 player. Apple iPod2 and multiple iRiver products were using this software.
